scope: Post-publication accepted 1.0.37 installed-state verification; not continuous natural-transition observation.
interpretation: Current installed bytes, manifest, retained staging and updater journals are consistent with successful application through the native helper. This lane did not observe the complete prior transition or establish a manual-free interval before observation.

dataComparisonLimit: Configuration bytes and startup registration match the inherited verified 1.0.36 baseline. evidenceBoundary: Private process identities, host paths and raw data snapshots are retained separately. This public projection excludes process IDs, process creation identities and host paths.
statusReporting: Authenticated per-session status reporting was unavailable in this observation lane.
